summary_en: This small pilot study tests metformin in people with pseudomyxoma peritonei caused by appendiceal mucinous neoplasms. The study is open-label, so the treatment is known to both patients and study staff. The record states that the goal is to find out whether metformin therapy is feasible.
summary_es: Este pequeño estudio piloto prueba la metformina en personas con pseudomixoma peritoneal causado por neoplasias mucinosas del apéndice. El estudio es abierto, por lo que se conoce el tratamiento tanto para los pacientes como para el personal del estudio. El registro indica que el objetivo es averiguar si el tratamiento con metformina es factible.
who_for: Pseudomyxoma peritonei from presumed appendiceal mucinous neoplasm that is recurrent or refractory after surgery and HIPEC
Pseudomyxoma peritonei without planned surgery and HIPEC
not_for: Resectable disease that is planned for cytoreductive surgery and HIPEC
Currently taking metformin for another medical reason
